records.name: repo-explore-unin-blocked-unchanged
records.conditions: a blocked uninstall changes nothing (premises PG, PW); bounds as in models/explorer/repo/REPORT.md part C

records.name: repo-explore-unin-honest
records.conditions: success exactly when the module is gone, both directions (premises PB, PG, PI, PNF); bounds as in models/explorer/repo/REPORT.md part C

records.name: repo-explore-unin-dependents-protect
records.conditions: a needed module stays without -force (premise PG); bounds as in models/explorer/repo/REPORT.md part C

records.name: repo-explore-unin-only-own
records.conditions: only the target's resources and records go, and its needs' with -r (premises PF, PNF); bounds as in models/explorer/repo/REPORT.md part C

records.name: repo-explore-unin-kept-files
records.conditions: files copied with the keep flag stay (premises PF, PNF); bounds as in models/explorer/repo/REPORT.md part C

records.name: repo-explore-unin-complete
records.conditions: once the record is gone, every non-exempt resource is gone (premises PGA, PNF); bounds as in models/explorer/repo/REPORT.md part C

records.name: repo-explore-unin-self-guard
records.conditions: uninstalling IPM runs the guard (premise PN); bounds as in models/explorer/repo/REPORT.md part C

records.name: repo-explore-unin-ipm-kept
records.conditions: IPM stays when another module is uninstalled (premise PI); bounds as in models/explorer/repo/REPORT.md part C

records.name: repo-explore-unin-clean-keeps-target
records.conditions: clean leaves its module unchanged (premises PCW, PF); bounds as in models/explorer/repo/REPORT.md part C

records.name: repo-explore-unin-rows-honest
records.conditions: a row says success exactly when its module is gone, both directions (premises PR, PB, PG, PNF, target not IPM); bounds as in models/explorer/repo/REPORT.md part C

records.name: repo-explore-unin-manifest-with-record
records.conditions: a removed record takes its stored manifest (premises PR, PNF); bounds as in models/explorer/repo/REPORT.md part C

records.name: repo-explore-unin-not-found
records.conditions: an unknown name fails and changes nothing (no premise); bounds as in models/explorer/repo/REPORT.md part C

records.name: repo-explore-set-config-get-after-set
records.conditions: config get returns the value config set stored (no premise); bounds as in models/explorer/repo/REPORT.md part C

records.name: repo-explore-set-config-delete-factory
records.conditions: config delete restores the factory default (premise PS); bounds as in models/explorer/repo/REPORT.md part C

records.name: repo-explore-set-config-shared
records.conditions: a setting set in one namespace is read in every namespace (no premise); bounds as in models/explorer/repo/REPORT.md part C

records.name: repo-explore-set-config-errors-unchanged
records.conditions: an unknown key or a bad value changes nothing (no premise); bounds as in models/explorer/repo/REPORT.md part C

records.name: repo-explore-set-dm-per-namespace
records.conditions: default modifiers set in one namespace change only that namespace (premise PNS); bounds as in models/explorer/repo/REPORT.md part C

records.name: repo-explore-set-dm-laws
records.conditions: -set adds without dropping, -delete clears, a typed option wins (no premise); bounds as in models/explorer/repo/REPORT.md part C

records.name: repo-explore-set-publish-default-enabled
records.conditions: publish with no -repo picks an enabled, non-folder registry (no premise); bounds as in models/explorer/repo/REPORT.md part C

records.name: repo-explore-set-publish-default-holder
records.conditions: publish with no -repo picks the publish-flag holder (premises PH, PU, PK); bounds as in models/explorer/repo/REPORT.md part C

records.name: repo-explore-set-publish-named
records.conditions: publish -r uses the named registry only if enabled (premise PE); bounds as in models/explorer/repo/REPORT.md part C

records.name: repo-explore-set-search-enabled
records.conditions: search lists only enabled registries (premise PE); bounds as in models/explorer/repo/REPORT.md part C

records.name: repo-explore-set-install-enabled
records.conditions: install takes only from enabled registries (no premise); bounds as in models/explorer/repo/REPORT.md part C

records.name: repo-explore-set-install-tie-sort-order
records.conditions: equal versions come from the lowest sort order (premise PT); bounds as in models/explorer/repo/REPORT.md part C

records.name: repo-twin-mutants-rejected
records.conditions: each twin mutant contradicted by at least one IRIS observation
